mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 7.0% signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 7.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST are above their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 235.0 indicates elevated inflation that triggers monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as rate hikes compress valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 per month indicates robust job growth that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) falling below its 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 17700 billion) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) creates favorable conditions for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 17700 and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals economic contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
